output.explanation: NIG-SA booked IC payable NIG-SA:ICV-SA-018989 at EUR 11,970.00 against NIG-DE's receivable NIG-DE:5100873413 of EUR 12,600.00 for the same invoice RE-2026-000314 (staff secondment P-25031). The buyer-to-seller ratio of 0.95 matches Saudi 5% WHT on services, and the buyer description explicitly states 'net of WHT 5%'. The remaining EUR 630.00 (USD 674.27 at the invoice-date rate) is tax withheld and remitted to the Saudi authority, not a missing payable.
output.recommended_action: NIG-SA should book the EUR 630.00 withheld tax so the full EUR 12,600.00 IC payable is reflected (or cleared via the WHT liability), and provide the WHT certificate to NIG-DE so it can recognise the tax credit/receivable instead of leaving an open IC difference.
output.adjustment_description: NIG-SA: gross up the IC payable to NIG-DE by EUR 630.00 against the WHT payable to the Saudi tax authority; NIG-DE: on receipt of the WHT certificate, reclassify EUR 630.00 from IC receivable to WHT tax receivable/expense.
